claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
Expanded enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, reusable workflow patterns, and usage-based forecasting that connected technical delivery to commercial priorities.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse environments, supporting vector services and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
